reasons.plausibility: Using a thin titanium interlayer to improve bonding and reduce interfacial defects in W–Cu composites is well-grounded in metallurgical principles, making the hypothesis scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: The proposed side-by-side fabrication and irradiation test under comparable conditions is a straightforward and decisive way to assess whether void formation is markedly reduced and thermal conductivity improved.
reasons.usefulness: It addresses a known challenge in W–Cu plasma-facing components by suggesting a practical coating intervention with clear, measurable performance outcomes.
